title: Half of the UN's elected council seats turn over each year
body: The UN Security Council has 15 members, including five permanent members. The General Assembly elects the remaining 10 for staggered 2-year terms, so five elected seats come up each year.
takeaway: Staggering terms changes who sits on the council without replacing every elected member at once.
source: United Nations, Security Council Membership FAQ
visual: semicircular desks and empty chairs in a softly lit council chamber

title: India lowered its voting age from 21 to 18
body: The Constitution's 61st Amendment changed the voting age in Article 326. The amendment, titled for 1988, replaced 21 with 18 for elections to the Lok Sabha and to state legislative assemblies.
takeaway: A change to one number alters which age groups have a voice in choosing representatives.
source: India Legislative Department, Constitution (Sixty-first Amendment) Act, 1988
visual: a young adult lowering a folded ballot into a plain ballot box
